name: Precog wARS
tagline: Reads Precog prediction-market odds in Spanish, and never trades
description: A Spanish-language lookup desk for Precog markets denominated in wARS, running across Base and Arbitrum. Ask about a question and it returns the current on-chain probability for each market, one result to a line, with no commentary layered on top. It is built without the ability to take a position.
author: ferminrp
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
